context:
Goal: the notes PRs for the push-after-check guard (#2191 and the PRs above it) keep moving tonight.
Problem (rule): the guard in the cloud session for lane notes-fix-large-3 is out of date. Its setup at session start could not fetch main, so it lacks the route that lets a test-author resolve both files of a test-and-code conflict. It refuses the merge for #2191. Re-running setup is an install write, which needs your typed words.
Based on (measured): the installed guard.py reads the merge state in 3 places; main's reads it in 6.
Departs from: an old guard copy, e2703c611 — this session's guard runs main's code (0e6509a96).
Meanwhile: the lane holds #2191 and the PRs above it, and goes on with #2144's round 3.

options.gain: The lane keeps its context and finishes tonight.
options.how: Type `re-run the install in notes-fix-large-3`. The lane re-runs the claude-settings install from main.
options.label: Re-run setup in the lane (Recommended)

options.how: The coordinator starts a fresh lane session. Its setup fetches main, and the old lane hands over its branches.
options.label: Start a fresh lane
options.lose: The stack's context, and a slower restart.

ref: PR #2191 and the PRs above it; lane notes-fix-large-3; debt install-stale-on-fetch-fail
reply: Closed at 01:38 CST Nov 10. The coordinator took option b, process only: a fresh lane session takes the stack, since it needs no owner word and can be undone. Debt install-stale-on-fetch-fail stays open. No answer needed from you.
title: Re-run setup in the notes lane, or start a fresh lane?
why: Lets the push-after-check notes PRs keep moving tonight; the lane cannot re-run setup without your typed words.
